text:
🚐 7-Day Coastal Road Trip: Sydney → Melbourne (Caravan & Campervan Friendly)

Day 1: Sydney → Jervis Bay

Distance: 200 km | Drive time: 3 hrs
Highlights:
•  Drive through the Royal National Park and along the Sea Cliff Bridge 🌉
•  Stop at Kiama Blowhole
•  Swim or relax at Hyams Beach, famous for its white sand

Stay: Huskisson Beach Holiday Park or Jervis Bay Holiday Park — both have powered sites and easy caravan access.
Tip: Book ahead in summer; parking can be tight in Huskisson town centre.

Day 2: Jervis Bay → Batemans Bay

Distance: 170 km | Drive time: 2.5 hrs
Highlights:
•  Explore Murramarang National Park
•  Stop in Ulladulla or Mollymook for seaside views
•  Spot kangaroos on the beach at Pebbly Beach

Stay: BIG4 Batemans Bay Beach Resort or NRMA Murramarang Beachfront Holiday Resort
Tip: Both offer excellent amenities for charging and water refill.

Day 3: Batemans Bay → Narooma

Distance: 70 km | Drive time: 1 hr
Highlights:
•  Walk the Narooma Boardwalk for stingray and seal spotting 🦭
•  Take a boat trip to Montague Island (penguins & fur seals)

Stay: Easts Holiday Park Narooma — large powered sites, oceanfront views.
Tip: Easy parking for both caravans and campervans right by the water.

Day 4: Narooma → Lakes Entrance (via Eden & Merimbula)

Distance: 330 km | Drive time: 4.5–5 hrs
Highlights:
•  Coffee stop in Merimbula
•  Explore Ben Boyd National Park and Eden Killer Whale Museum
•  Arrive at Lakes Entrance, gateway to the Gippsland Lakes

Stay: NRMA Eastern Beach Holiday Park or BIG4 Whiters Holiday Village
Tip: Both towns (Eden & Lakes Entrance) are caravan-friendly with dump points and EV/car charging nearby.

Day 5: Lakes Entrance → Wilsons Promontory

Distance: 300 km | Drive time: 4 hrs
Highlights:
•  Scenic drive through rolling farmland
•  Stop at Sale or Yarram for a meal
•  Arrive at Wilsons Promontory National Park, one of Australia’s most beautiful natural areas

Stay: Tidal River Campground (book early — limited powered sites).
Tip: Narrow roads inside the park — drive slowly, but suitable for caravans under 7m.

Day 6: Wilsons Promontory → Phillip Island

Distance: 190 km | Drive time: 3 hrs
Highlights:
•  Visit Inverloch coastal cliffs
•  Watch the Penguin Parade at Phillip Island 🐧
•  Check out Koala Conservation Reserve

Stay: Anchor Belle Holiday Park or BIG4 Phillip Island Caravan Park
Tip: Great facilities for recharging — powered sites, Wi-Fi, and hot showers.

Day 7: Phillip Island → Melbourne

Distance: 140 km | Drive time: 2 hrs
Highlights:
•  Detour through the Mornington Peninsula for wineries and hot springs 🍷♨️
•  Cross via Peninsula Link or Sorrento–Queenscliff Ferry (optional scenic ferry route for vans)
•  Arrive in Melbourne 🚐

Stay: Discovery Parks Melbourne or BIG4 Melbourne Holiday Park — both convenient for unloading and exploring the city.

⚡ Trip Notes
•  Total Distance: 1,307km
•  Fuel/Charge stops: Major towns every 100–150 km (ample EV charging & caravan facilities)
•  Best travel season: October–April (pleasant weather & longer daylight)
•  Travel pace: 3–5 hrs driving per day, plenty of scenic stops

Safe Travels 😊

✈️ We travel quite a bit.

This morning is no different. One of the coolest things about doing what we do is getting to travel all over the United States teaching people how to dance. Our hope one day is to go international! How cool would that be?! 🤠

Don’t get us wrong, we love the freedom. We are infinitely grateful everyday we get wake up doing this, but it’s hard sometimes. Traveling and vacationing are two VERY different things 🤣 We’ve gotten smarter over the years and try to build in time to experience a little of wherever we are. We sacrifice sleep to make workshop weekends cheaper for communities. We leave behind our beloved dog who is getting older each passing day. Food is usually a stresser for us since we eat a pretty clean whole-food meat-based diet. Unfortunately, options are limited and usually expensive. 

All that to say, events and workshop weekends are still one of our most favorite things about our jobs! The pros absolutely outweigh the cons. We love watching communities grow and unite. We love bringing awareness to local instructors to aid in keeping dance alive all over the nation. And maybe, just maybe, change someone’s life and inspire them. ❤️ 

What are your best travel tips?! AND tell us about the most inspiring workshop weekend you’ve ever attended!! 👀

🇨🇭🇮🇹 ¡DOS PAÍSES SEPARADOS POR APENAS UNOS METROS! EL INCREÍBLE LUGAR DONDE SUIZA E ITALIA CASI SE TOCAN

🌍 Aunque Suiza e Italia comparten cientos de kilómetros de frontera, existe un rincón especialmente curioso donde dos comunidades de ambos países se encuentran separadas por una distancia sorprendentemente pequeña.

🏘️ Se trata de Lavena Ponte Tresa, en Italia, y Ponte Tresa, en Suiza, dos localidades que parecen formar parte de un mismo pueblo, pero pertenecen a países diferentes.

🌊 Entre ambas se encuentra el río Tresa, que nace del lago de Lugano y sirve como frontera natural en esta zona. En algunos puntos, la distancia entre las orillas es de apenas unas decenas de metros.

🚶‍♂️ Lo más impresionante es que puedes pasar de Italia a Suiza caminando por un puente en cuestión de segundos.

🇮🇹 De un lado encontrarás calles italianas, cafeterías, restaurantes y comercios donde se utiliza el euro.

🇨🇭 Del otro estarás en territorio suizo, donde la moneda oficial es el franco suizo y encontrarás una administración y normas diferentes.

📸 Desde el aire, las casas, los tejados y la vegetación parecen pertenecer a una sola localidad. Sin embargo, una frontera internacional atraviesa este pequeño paisaje europeo.

✨ Es uno de esos lugares que demuestran lo curioso que puede ser viajar por Europa: dos países, dos sistemas diferentes y apenas unos pasos de distancia.

❤️ ¿Te gustaría visitar un lugar donde puedes desayunar en Italia y cruzar caminando a Suiza para tomar un café?

text:
200 пассажиров "круиза на всю жизнь" высадили в Камбодже из-за роста цен на топливо. Американская компания Villa Vie Residences внезапно приостановила эксплуатацию круизного лайнера Odyssey через два года после начала кругосветного путешествия. Пассажирам дали семь часов, чтобы собрать вещи и покинуть судно во время остановки в камбоджийском Сиануквиле, пишет APF.
 
Круиз рекламировался как "бесконечное путешествие": люди могли купить или арендовать каюту на время отпуска или даже на всю жизнь. Некоторые продали все свое имущество, чтобы поселиться на корабле.
 
Американец Рэнди Кассингем и его жена потратили на путешествие около миллиона долларов и рассчитывали прожить на лайнере не менее 15 лет. За два года они посетили 65 стран. Несмотря на произошедшее, Кассингем не жалеет о своем решении. "Если они смогут возобновить работу, мы подумаем о возвращении", - приводит его слова агентство.
 
Компания объяснила остановку работы резким ростом цен на топливо после начала войны с Ираном. Ежемесячные расходы на горючее в пересчете на одну каюту "выросли с 1800 до 6000-8000 долларов". The Austin-Bergstrom International Airport has identified 12 international cities that it classifies as “priority markets” for new nonstop service.

“Austin has become — has been but even more now — a global tourism brand. So we’re seeing more and more people from all over the world coming to Austin and visiting here,” Kevin Schorr, vice president of Campbell-Hill Aviation Group, said at a meeting of the Austin Airport Advisory Commission last month. The group works with both airlines and airports, including AUS, to secure new nonstop service.

In a presentation to the commission, Schorr identified 12 cities that AUS considers priorities: Bogotá, Dubai, Dublin, Guadalajara, Istanbul, Lima, Montego Bay, Paris, Reykjavík, San Jose, Seoul and Tokyo.

The airport already has nonstop service to 13 international destinations, while flights to Grand Cayman are set to begin in May.

The list of priority routes has expanded since 2019, when Amsterdam, Beijing, Dublin, Paris, Seoul, Shanghai and Tokyo were identified. Nonstop service to Amsterdam began in March 2022.

When it comes to new flights to Asia, Schorr said AUS is competing with other large airports in the U.S. without direct flights to the continent — like Portland, Nashville, Charlotte and Philadelphia — as well as those with existing service.

“It’s our duty to make sure that the airlines understand why Austin is that next best opportunity over any of the other airports that you see here,” Schorr said. “We’re also competiting with those existing markets in the United States where carriers can also add additional flights.”

He said there are several factors that set Austin apart, including the significant growth in Asian-owned businesses and the Asian community in Central Texas. That leads to heavy demand for nonstop flights.

Also working in AUS’ favor — other international airlines have already entered the market and have expanded service. If an airline considering Austin sees that other airlines have been successful, it gets them more confidence, Schorr said.

While Schorr couldn’t disclose which specific airlines or routes Campbell-Hill is currently negotiating with, he did say they are “pursuing a number of different carriers right now.”

The airport offers incentives to airlines who bring new service, including covering marketing costs and waiving airport fees. The current incentives, set in 2019 and amended in 2021, include up to $500,000 in advertising and marketing costs over a two-year period. An airport spokesperson told KXAN the incentive program is currently undergoing its regularly-scheduled five-year update.

SATPIC & CURRENT:
The Vis Satpic shows the Basin blanketed in thin layer of stratocumulus, which is usually evident of a decent low level inversion. Checking the mornings balloon data, there’s a fairly hefty inversion around 1-1.5km up, with Temps rising ~10ºC and dewpoints dropping ~10ºC. This may delay the current cloud from breaking up/burning off, esp if the seabreeze arrives early. On the water vapour Satpic, there’s substantial tropical moisture building to the NW, which may come into play tomorrow PM. 

TODAY’S FORECAST: 22-28ºC
Partly cloudy, mild & humid morning. Most models anticipate the cloud clearing to a mostly sunny PM BUT as I outlined, that inversion may stop that happening and merely trap the seabreeze moisture on the surface creating more low level cloud. Staying dry though. Temps will very much be dependent on that cloud clearing, but 22-28ºC is forecast, with the East staying 22-24ºC thanks to a mod-gusty NE’erly seabreeze due ~12-1pm.

TONIGHT'S FORECAST: 14-18ºC
Staying partly cloudy, mild, dry & humid thanks to that raging NE’erly seabreeze which won’t ease til later this evening. Overnight a more N’erly flow will also push in ahead of tomorrow’s unsettled weather. Temps 14-18ºC

And that’s the Fri morning briefing dione & dusted. Overall, a decent end to the week, not hot, not cold, not wet, Temps a decent 22-28ºC with that NE’erly seabreeze raging from around lunch. And better still, tomorrow, aka Halloween, forecast is starting to look interesting… trick or trashed?

Une hôtesse de l'air m'a remis discrètement une note : « Soyez la dernière personne à quitter cet avion. » Ce qui s'est déroulé à l'aéroport m'a glacialement marqué.

Je m'appelle Natalie, j'ai 32 ans ; jeudi dernier, je voyageais en avion de Boston à Chicago, revenant d'une visite à ma sœur. Tout semblait anodin jusqu'à environ une heure après le départ, quand une hôtesse appelée Rebecca s'est approchée avec un verre d'eau. Discrètement, elle glissa un petit papier dans la serviette en me le tendant.

Sous la tablette, j'ai ouvert le mot, pensant à une offre commerciale. Il disait : « Vous devez être la dernière personne à quitter cet avion. N'en parlez à personne. Faites-moi confiance. » Mon cœur s'accéléra brusquement. Rebecca, debout près de la cabine arrière, me fixait d'un air grave.

J'ai essayé de croiser son regard, mais elle fit non de la tête, en silence. Peu après, traversant à nouveau l'allée, j'ai chuchoté : « Que se passe-t-il ? Suis-je en danger ? » Elle répondit brièvement : « S'il vous plaît, faites exactement ce qui est écrit sur le mot. Je vous expliquerai tout à l'atterrissage. »

Le reste du trajet, mes pensées étaient troublées, à l'affût du moindre signe étrange chez les passagers. Une fois au sol, je restai sur mon siège alors que tout le monde ramassait ses effets et quittait la cabine.

Quand il ne resta plus que moi, Rebecca vint, nerveuse. « Tu es prête ? » murmura-t-elle. « Prête pour quoi ? » répondis-je. Au lieu d'expliquer, elle montra seulement la porte ouverte.

J'ai pris mon sac, la suivant dans le couloir. À peine sortie de l'avion, la scène à l'extérieur m'a profondément troublée.

text:
Mi hija se mudó con una familia anfitriona en Alemania para un programa de intercambio — todo parecía perfecto hasta que dejó de contestar mis llamadas. Entonces, a la 1:43 de la madrugada, me llamó susurrando: "Mamá, por favor, sácame de aquí".

Mi hija Emily, de 16 años, llevaba años soñando con estudiar en el extranjero. Cuando la aceptaron en un programa de intercambio de secundaria en Alemania, apenas podía contener la emoción.

Habíamos hecho varias videollamadas con su familia anfitriona antes del viaje. Susan y Michael parecían encantadores. Tenían dos hijos adolescentes e incluso nos enseñaron la habitación que habían preparado para Emily.

Cuando la recogieron en el aeropuerto, Susan me envió una foto. Mi hija estaba entre ellos, sonriendo, con ambos padres anfitriones abrazándola.

"¿Ves, mamá? ¡Te dije que son encantadores!", me escribió Emily por mensaje.

Esa misma noche, me envió otro mensaje.

¡Mamá, vamos a cenar! Tienen una regla: después de la cena todos entregan sus teléfonos para que haya un rato de silencio. Te escribo mañana. ¡Te quiero!

La regla me pareció un poco extraña, pero no la cuestioné. Al fin y al cabo, el objetivo de un programa de intercambio era experimentar la vida en otra familia, incluyendo sus rutinas y normas de convivencia.

Incluso le había recordado a Emily antes del viaje que respetara a quienes la acogían en su casa.

Así que le respondí: "¡Que te diviertas, cariño! ¡Yo también te quiero!".

A la mañana siguiente, le envié un mensaje.

"¡Buenos días, cariño! ¿Qué tal tu primera noche?".

No contestó.

A la hora del almuerzo, lo intenté de nuevo.

"¿Cómo va todo? ¡Mándame una foto!".

Seguía sin contestar.

Supuse que estaría ocupada conociendo a su nueva familia.

Pero a las 8 de la noche, la llamé dos veces. Ambas llamadas fueron directamente al buzón de voz.

Finalmente, le escribí a Susan. "¡Hola, Susan! Solo quería saber cómo está Emily. No he sabido nada de ella en todo el día".

Veinte minutos después, respondió.

"¡Está perfectamente! Lo estamos pasando de maravilla. Se está acostumbrando a nuestra rutina familiar. ¡No te preocupes!".

"¿Podría llamarme un minuto?", pregunté.

Susan leyó el mensaje.

No respondió.

A las 11 de la noche, mi marido me dijo que me fuera a dormir.

"Tiene dieciséis años. Seguro que se lo está pasando en grande".

Dejé el móvil en la mesita de noche, con el timbre a todo volumen.

A la 1:43 de la madrugada, sonó.

Emily.

Contesté antes del segundo timbrazo.

"¡Cariño! ¡Llevo todo el día intentando contactar contigo!".

"¿Mamá?".

Su voz era apenas un susurro.

¿Emily? Cariño, ¿qué te pasa?

Mamá, por favor... ¿puedes venir a buscarme?

Me incorporé en la cama.

¿Qué pasó? ¿Estás herida?

No. Mamá, solo escucha. Necesito que me saques de esta casa.

Está bien, cariño. Dime qué ocurre. ¿Dónde estás?

Hubo una pausa... Entonces oí pasos.

Around 200 tourists who paid to spend 15 years living on a luxury cruise ship have been abandoned in Cambodia with just hours to pack their bags. ‼️

Hundreds of passengers aboard the Villa Vie Odyssey have been left stranded with no help for accommodation or onward travel. 💔

Residents had ploughed their money into a continuous 15-year world voyage only to be told the entire operation was suddenly suspended.

An announcement flashed up on the internal messaging board at 6.30am telling everyone they had until 2pm to pack up all their belongings and get off. 

The memo bluntly stated: "Unfortunately, we were unable to secure the fuel necessary to continue operations."

It added: "All residents must disembark by 2pm today."

Passenger Randy Cassingham slammed the firm's leadership for refusing to say sorry as travellers scrambled into local hotels.

He said: "She's the freaking CEO, and couldn't bring herself to say it."

Another passenger, Thomas, confirmed they received no assistance once forced down the gangway into Cambodia.

She said: "Note that as per usual Villa Vie has put their spin on things; they are offering no help with lodging, travel arrangements or anything."

Florida-based Villa Vie Residences blamed the Iran War and soaring fuel prices for creating unsustainable financial pressure.

Company bosses say crew will stay onboard for a temporary layup while they seek emergency funding, warning that no outcome is assured over the next 60 days.

🌿 **BLUE MOUNTAINS – ĐIỂM ĐẾN KHÔNG THỂ BỎ LỠ KHI DU LỊCH SYDNEY 🇦🇺**

Nếu đã đến Sydney mà chưa một lần khám phá Blue Mountains, bạn có thể đã bỏ lỡ một trong những cảnh đẹp thiên nhiên ấn tượng nhất của nước Úc! 💚

🏞️ **Vì sao Blue Mountains luôn nằm trong danh sách những nơi đáng đi nhất?**

✨ **Chiêm ngưỡng thiên nhiên hùng vĩ:** Những dãy núi trùng điệp, thung lũng xanh ngút ngàn và vách đá sa thạch kỳ vĩ tạo nên khung cảnh khiến bạn chỉ muốn đứng thật lâu để ngắm nhìn.

🚠 **Trải nghiệm cáp treo ngắm núi rừng:** Thu trọn vẻ đẹp bao la của thung lũng từ trên cao, một trải nghiệm vừa thư giãn vừa đầy ấn tượng.

🚂 **Thử thách bản thân với chuyến tàu dốc nhất thế giới:** Scenic Railway mang đến cảm giác phấn khích khi len qua khu rừng nhiệt đới xanh mát. Đây cũng là một trong những trải nghiệm được nhiều du khách yêu thích tại Blue Mountains.

🦘 **Gặp gỡ những người bạn bản địa của nước Úc:** Có cơ hội ngắm nhìn kangaroo và các loài động vật đặc trưng của Australia tại những điểm tham quan phù hợp trong hành trình.

📸 **Điểm đến lý tưởng cho những bức ảnh đáng nhớ:** Dù đi cùng gia đình, người thương hay nhóm bạn, mỗi góc nhìn tại Blue Mountains đều có thể trở thành một kỷ niệm đẹp trong chuyến đi Australia.

🌫️ Đặc biệt, vào những ngày sương mù bao phủ, núi rừng khoác lên mình vẻ đẹp huyền ảo, khiến cả hành trình như bước vào một bức tranh thiên nhiên sống động.

💚 **Điều tuyệt vời nhất là bạn không cần tự mình lên kế hoạch phức tạp!**

Cùng **Sydney Daily Tour**, bạn có thể tận hưởng hành trình khám phá Blue Mountains với lịch trình được sắp xếp chu đáo, những điểm tham quan nổi bật và sự đồng hành tận tình của đội ngũ hướng dẫn viên.

Let's talk about contamination. 

There is 'clamshells in the recycling' kind of contamination where the clamshells are sorted out and thrown away - very little impact on the recyclable material (but remember, #1 & 2 plastic bottles only). 

There is 'green waste in the recycling' kind of contamination where more recyclable material falls victim to contamination (PLEASE leave green waste, food waste, and garbage OUT of the recycling). 

And then there is 'paint in the recycling' kind of contamination that causes whole truckloads of recycling to be thrown away as garbage AND expensive cleaning that has to take place. We aren't sure why we need to say it, but PAINT ABSOLUTELY DOES NOT BELONG IN THE REYCLING!!!

Our recycling is taken to an independent business local to Cache County to be processed. More than the loss of a whole truck full of recycling, this is really hard on a their operations. PLEASE make sure you are only putting recyclable items in the recycling containers.

分類多用心，焚化更省心！邀請您一同攜手，為環境保護及營運安全盡一份心
焚化廠是城市衛生與廢棄物處置的守護者， 然而，當未落實分類的垃圾（如高熱值塑膠、回收金屬、含水廢棄物或易爆危險物品）混入一般垃圾進焚化廠時，將對焚化系統與現場人員帶來嚴峻的挑戰及風險。
【回收三要點，請您與我們一起做】：
1. 危險物品單獨處理： 瓦斯罐、高壓噴霧罐、高容量鋰電池與行動電源等，請交由清潔隊資源回收車或其他回收管道，切勿丟入一般垃圾！
2. 廚餘水分瀝乾再丟： 廚餘請確實瀝乾水分並丟棄至廚餘回收桶，減少焚化爐負擔。
3. 資源回收物確實分類： 紙類、寶特瓶、金屬罐與塑膠容器請分開回收，讓資源重獲新生，不進入焚化爐燃燒。
乾淨美好的城市，需要我們共同守護。只要大家在生活中多花一分鐘做好垃圾分類，就是對我們居住城市最深切的愛護！

¡EMERGENCIA SANITARIA! ‼️🚨 Es hora de separar la basura en #Zacatelco  ♻️🗑️

El presidente municipal, José Miguel Acatzi Luna, anunció la campaña “Zacatelco Limpio”, que iniciará el próximo 3 de noviembre con un nuevo esquema de recolección de residuos para fomentar la separación y el reciclaje. 🌎

📅 Este será el calendario de recolección:

🟢 Lunes, miércoles y viernes: basura orgánica.

🔵 Martes, jueves y sábado: basura inorgánica y reciclables.

🚛 La medida aplicará tanto para los camiones del Ayuntamiento como para los recolectores particulares y las motocicletas que prestan este servicio.

🚨 ¡Importante! La basura que no esté separada no será recibida. Tampoco se recolectarán llantas, escombros de construcción, aparatos electrónicos, pilas ni animales muertos.

🌱 La estrategia contempla impulsar la elaboración de composta con restos de frutas, verduras y pasto, además del reciclaje de papel, vidrio y plástico. También se brindará asesoría a escuelas para promover estas prácticas.

⚠️ Las autoridades exhortaron a la población a no tirar basura en drenajes, barrancas, ríos o terrenos baldíos, ni quemar residuos.

📍 Los desechos recolectados serán trasladados a la Ciudad Industrial Xicohténcatl I.

🌎 Con “Zacatelco Limpio”, el Ayuntamiento busca impulsar una nueva cultura en el manejo de los residuos. La separación comenzará desde casa y será una medida para quienes recolectan la basura en el municipio.

Some people see garbage. Others see a problem. But Sammy Mob saw something different. He saw opportunity wealth and a future.

Sammy’s journey began humbly, collecting garbage and selling recovered waste to earn a living. But he believed that what others threw away still had value. Along the way, he met people who believed in his dream and invested in his vision.

Today, the man who started as a simple garbage collector has grown into one of the major waste aggregators, running a structured enterprise with a full management team and employing close to 150 people.

His operation receives and processes paper and plastic waste, preparing materials for recycling and manufacturing. Through this circular value chain, broken plastic pipes become new pipes, discarded buckets become new buckets, and old plastic chairs become new chairs. This is circularity in action.

For Sammy, conservation is not just about protecting the environment. It is about creating wealth, building businesses, generating employment, and ensuring valuable resources don't end up in dumpsites.

And perhaps the most inspiring part of Sammy’s journey is that he has not only transformed his own life. He has created livelihoods for nearly 150 others.

Sammy Mob is the poster child for circularity.

text:
Many households are guilty of tossing every scrap of paper, plastic, metal, or glass into their recycling bins, assuming it'll all be dealt with accordingly. 

Sadly, recycling is far more complex than that, with vastly different standards operating across the country.

While ordinary sheets of paper can absolutely be recycled at home, shredded paper is a different matter entirely. It may seem like an obvious candidate for recycling, but many local councils actually refuse to accept it.

Binman Ashley, better known as viral TikTok sensation The No1 Binman, has urged households to "stop putting shredded paper in your paper bin".

Taking to social media, the binman said, "It's [shredded paper] not recyclable because you broke it down too much. It's too much effort and costs too much money to recycle it in your normal [recycling] bins. So don't put it in there."

Ashley also pointed out that shredded paper in recycling bins makes life considerably harder for binmen.

He explained, "When we tip it when it's cold, windy, and wet, it goes everywhere, and then we have to try and get it off the floor, sweeping it up - it all sticks to the floor. It's horrible."

Instead, Ashley advises households to dispose of shredded paper in their general waste bins, as the vast majority of the time it simply cannot be recycled.

However, if your local council does accept shredded paper, Ashley recommends, "Put it [the shredded paper] in a Primark bag or something like a paper bag so it doesn't go everywhere."

Why can't I recycle shredded paper at home?

Shredded paper can be recycled in some instances, but not every local council will accept it for recycling, as certain paper mills are unable to process it.

This is because the shredding process weakens the paper, and it may cause issues at paper mills, such as maintenance problems and fire hazard risks.

If your council won't collect it for recycling, you can simply put it in your general waste bin as advised by The No1 Binman, drop it off at a paper bank, or place non-glossy shredded paper at the bottom of your food waste recycling bin to absorb any liquid and help stop dripping.

Households can also add it to their home compost heap, though not if it's coloured or glossy paper, as these can contain chemicals that are damaging to plants.

✍Angela Patrone

text:
Many households are guilty of tossing every scrap of paper, plastic, metal, or glass into their recycling bins, assuming it'll all be dealt with accordingly. 

Sadly, recycling is far more complex than that, with vastly different standards operating across the country.

While ordinary sheets of paper can absolutely be recycled at home, shredded paper is a different matter entirely. It may seem like an obvious candidate for recycling, but many local councils actually refuse to accept it.

Binman Ashley, better known as viral TikTok sensation The No1 Binman, has urged households to "stop putting shredded paper in your paper bin".

Taking to social media, the binman said, "It's [shredded paper] not recyclable because you broke it down too much. It's too much effort and costs too much money to recycle it in your normal [recycling] bins. So don't put it in there."

Ashley also pointed out that shredded paper in recycling bins makes life considerably harder for binmen.

He explained, "When we tip it when it's cold, windy, and wet, it goes everywhere, and then we have to try and get it off the floor, sweeping it up - it all sticks to the floor. It's horrible."

Instead, Ashley advises households to dispose of shredded paper in their general waste bins, as the vast majority of the time it simply cannot be recycled.

However, if your local council does accept shredded paper, Ashley recommends, "Put it [the shredded paper] in a Primark bag or something like a paper bag so it doesn't go everywhere."

Why can't I recycle shredded paper at home?

Shredded paper can be recycled in some instances, but not every local council will accept it for recycling, as certain paper mills are unable to process it.

This is because the shredding process weakens the paper, and it may cause issues at paper mills, such as maintenance problems and fire hazard risks.

If your council won't collect it for recycling, you can simply put it in your general waste bin as advised by The No1 Binman, drop it off at a paper bank, or place non-glossy shredded paper at the bottom of your food waste recycling bin to absorb any liquid and help stop dripping.

Households can also add it to their home compost heap, though not if it's coloured or glossy paper, as these can contain chemicals that are damaging to plants.

✍Angela Patrone

In Sydney’s south west, three people have been arrested and five trail bikes seized after police responded to community reports of dangerous riding along Heathcote Road at Moorebank.

The incident unfolded about 11.20am on Thursday, 29 October 2026, when officers from Traffic and Highway Patrol Command’s Strike Force Puma were called to reports of trail bikes allegedly being ridden dangerously along the road.

Police will allege the riders travelled at high speeds and crossed onto the wrong side of the roadway, creating potential dangers for other motorists.

Following inquiries involving the Public Order and Riot Squad, Dog Unit and PolAir, officers arrested two men, aged 18 and 22, and a 19-year-old woman shortly after 1pm in a carpark on Banksia Road, Greenacre.

Police seized five trail bikes for forensic examination. Investigators will allege three were unregistered, one had been reported stolen and another had no number plates.

The 19-year-old woman was issued a traffic infringement notice for allegedly failing to wear an approved helmet.

Both men were issued Field Court Attendance Notices for allegedly driving in a manner dangerous to the public and exceeding the speed limit by more than 45km/h.

They are due to appear before Bankstown Local Court on Wednesday, 11 November 2026.

Police investigations remain ongoing.

text:
In 2018, the city of Kwinana in Western Australia introduced a simple idea to stop rubbish from washing into waterways. They installed mesh nets over stormwater drains to catch litter, plastic, paper, leaves and other debris before it could reach rivers and oceans.

The results came quickly. Within just three months, the nets collected around 370 kilograms (815 pounds) of waste.

Instead of sending everything straight to landfill, the collected rubbish was sorted. Recyclable materials were processed, while organic waste was turned into mulch.

The entire project cost less than $20,000, including design and installation, and attracted international attention from other communities looking for practical ways to reduce water pollution.

Environmental solutions don’t always need to be complicated or expensive. Sometimes, a relatively small investment in a well-designed system can prevent a much bigger problem downstream.

Imagine what could happen if more cities adopted simple, effective ideas like this to keep garbage out of our waterways. Prevention is often cheaper, smarter and more effective than trying to clean up the damage after it’s already been done.

text:
Good news for the ocean! Releasing helium balloons in NSW is now banned. 🙌🎈

The NSW Government has passed new reforms to reduce plastic pollution, and the balloon release ban is one of them.

Released balloons can end up far out at sea and when they burst, the shredded pieces can look a lot like jellyfish, and turtles, seabirds and other marine animals mistake them for food. Their ribbons and strings can also tangle marine life.

Other measures in the reforms include:

Soy sauce fish containers must be recyclable by 2030
Fruit and vegetable stickers must be compostable by 2030
Takeaway coffee cups must be recyclable from 2028

We welcome these steps, which will help reduce the amount of plastic entering our waterways and threatening marine life. But plastic pollution doesn’t stop at state borders. We urge governments to go further, and that means a strong Global Plastics Treaty.

Congratulations and thank you to everyone who has campaigned for this cause for so long! 💪🙌💙

Gather those empty bottles and let's make them into beautiful flower pots together! A simple upcycle that gives discarded bottles a new purpose. 🌱

1. First, collect the prepared empty bottles, wash them one by one until clean and let them dry, so they're ready for making flower pots later.

2. Shape the bottle body according to the flower pot design you want, cutting out a suitable opening—be careful of the cut edges and your hands while doing this.

3. Smooth out the cut edges of the bottle carefully, then leave a drainage spot at the bottom so the flower pot is more convenient to use.

4. Put a suitable amount of soil into the prepared bottle, then plant your favorite plants and gently tidy the plants and soil surface.

5. Once done, arrange the bottle flower pots neatly, water and care for them as needed—simple recycling can also become a beautiful decoration.

Au Vietnam, CMA CGM, dont le siège est à Marseille, s’associe à Nike et à l’entreprise vietnamienne Gemadept pour lancer une barge 100 % électrique. Alimentée par des batteries et rechargée grâce à l’énergie solaire, elle assurera une liaison de 180 km aller-retour entre un site logistique de Nike et le terminal maritime de Gemalink.

Capable de transporter plus de 50 000 conteneurs EVP par an, cette nouvelle solution devrait permettre d’éviter environ 778 tonnes de CO₂ chaque année. Une nouvelle étape dans la collaboration entre CMA CGM et Nike, qui travaillent déjà ensemble depuis 2023 à réduire les émissions liées au transport maritime.

📷 : CMA CGM
